name: Quantum Systems
description: Quantum Systems is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Quantum Systems is a privately held defense technology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $1.2 billion Series D round announced on July 2, 2026, valued the company at $8 billion.

Founded in 2015 and based in Gilching, near Munich, Quantum Systems develops and manufactures unmanned aircraft and other uncrewed systems, together with software that links them, for defense, security and civil customers. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Figures are in U.S. dollars; Quantum Systems announced its 2025 rounds in euros. Valuations are as announced by the company, and the Series D valuation is post-money. The Series C extension amount is as reported by Reuters.
round_notes: Blackstone, Noteus, Airbus and Advent co-led the Series D, and Airbus Defence and Space agreed at the same time to deepen its collaboration with the company. Quantum Systems has said its systems carried out more than 19,000 missions in Ukraine in 2025; that figure is the company's own.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Blackstone, Noteus, Airbus and Advent co-led the Series D, with participation from Bond, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Wellington Management, A.P. Moller Holding and Elephant Lake Ventures, as well as existing shareholders Balderton and HV Capital. Balderton Capital led the Series C and its extension. Other investors include Hensoldt, Bullhound Capital, Porsche SE, Project A, DTCP, Airbus Ventures and Peter Thiel.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Quantum Systems appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Quantum Systems' announcements of its Series D (July 2, 2026), Series C extension (November 28, 2025) and Series C (May 6, 2025); a report by The Robot Report (July 2026); reports by Reuters; and SEC Form D filings.
